searchText: If we go with this, we should also update `access_cost` definition in the pre-state validation table to not include the cold access surcharge I like that this flow avoids unnecessary accesses and wasted work and pairs BAL insertion with warming, but it affects not only BAL inclusion but also gas accounting. Besu can implement either direction, however it's not a small change and I’m not fully convinced the benefit is worth expanding the consensus change surface. I don't have a hard objection either way and my understanding is that Besu (cc <@680337202521440470> ) would slightly prefer avoiding gas accounting changes. My guide on this is if i would design the order today, what would it be Personally, I'd prefer to avoid a change to the gas part. At least for this fork. We already has a lot of changes in that area. And adding yet another big change that isn't directly link to BAL seems too much imo
